passages.text:
Hi Shimz,
Wearing the hat of PSE here (+Brent). I think it would make sense to elevate this to a Mission-wide meeting so that other
offices get to meet Facebook/ Meta and see potential opportunities. Some companies, such as Facebook especially,
would be relevant across different tech offices. The other way of doing it is to have a short meeting with Ryan first then
have a follow up working level (Directors, staff esp those who are part of the PSE Working Group) meeting/briefing.
John is also in touch with Amazon and we're thinking of a Mission-wide PSE meeting with them as well.
Jay

Hi Shimz,
Wearing the hat of PSE here (+Brent). I think it would make sense to elevate this to a Mission-wide meeting so that other
offices get to meet Facebook/ Meta and see potential opportunities. Some companies, such as Facebook especially,
would be relevant across different tech offices. The other way of doing it is to have a short meeting with Ryan first then
have a follow up working level (Directors, staff esp those who are part of the PSE Working Group) meeting/briefing.
John is also in touch with Amazon and we're thinking of a Mission-wide PSE meeting with them as well.
Jay
